defect.description: Embedded kernel __TEXT.vmsize extends over __DATA_CONST, although its file-backed bytes and sections end before DATA_CONST. XNU uses this nested header for protection ranges.

source_sequence: It next maps __DATA_CONST RWNX with ALLOW_BLOCK but without ALLOW_HINT.
While kva_active is false, overlapping entries may be rewritten without the active-mapping hint-consistency assertion firing.
At attempt005 alignment, the DATA_CONST update replaces only a suffix of a previously complete hinted group, leaving mixed permissions and hint bits.
mapping_mechanism.source_contract: The initial DATA_CONST mapping is intended to remain writable during startup; arm_vm_prot_finalize tightens it much later. This is not a valid early-lockdown write.
mapping_mechanism.inference_boundary: The loaded header defect and the source-derived mixed-hint group are established. The observed permission fault is consistent with the CPU using the remaining RO hinted group, but active page tables and TLB state were not captured. Do not claim direct observation of hardware coalescing or a specific stale TLB entry.
